nodes.name: bug
nodes.description: Something isn't working

nodes.name: epic
nodes.description: Tehas: an epic; its parts are its sub-issues (added to a title that starts with Epic)

nodes.name: needs-human-attention
nodes.description: Cycle parked; the handoff comment says what to do

nodes.name: tehas:awaiting-merge
nodes.description: Tehas: PR open, only the merge left to a human

nodes.name: tehas:blocked
nodes.description: Tehas: started once every issue it names is closed

nodes.name: tehas:classic
nodes.description: Tehas: run this issue on the classic driver where TEHAS_DRIVER=lean (apply by hand)

nodes.name: tehas:finish
nodes.description: Tehas: open the draft PR of a stopped cycle; a marked comment gives the reason

nodes.name: tehas:improvement
nodes.description: Tehas: filed by the factory, a proposal

nodes.name: tehas:lean
nodes.description: Tehas: run this issue on the lean driver (apply by hand; tehas:ready still starts it)

nodes.name: tehas:millwright-escalated
nodes.description: Tehas: the millwright left this issue to a person

nodes.name: tehas:pause
nodes.description: Tehas: on the control issue, stops all dispatch

nodes.name: tehas:plan
nodes.description: Tehas: start a planning session on this issue (apply by hand)

nodes.name: tehas:planning
nodes.description: Tehas: a planning turn is running for this issue

nodes.name: tehas:question
nodes.description: Tehas: a question on this issue waits for an answer

nodes.name: tehas:ready
nodes.description: Tehas: eligible for dispatch (apply by hand to authorize a cycle)

nodes.name: tehas:refine
nodes.description: Tehas: plan this request into one issue sized for one cycle (apply by hand)

nodes.name: tehas:refined
nodes.description: Tehas: refined; later parts are planned by hand

nodes.name: tehas:refreshing
nodes.description: Tehas: a cycle is refreshing this pull request; do not merge or push now

nodes.name: tehas:replaced
nodes.description: Tehas: replaced by the issue a refine filed

nodes.name: tehas:running
nodes.description: Tehas: a /work cycle owns this issue

nodes.name: tehas:shipped
nodes.description: Tehas: closed by a merged pull request (given by the bot)
